jsesh.hieroglyphs
Class LigatureZone

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.hieroglyphs.LigatureZone
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.Cloneable
public class LigatureZone
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Cloneable

A zone near hieroglyph which will be used for ligatures. The zone is defined by a rectangular area (could be something else in the future), and a "gravity" which states where the groups which will be ligatured in this zone will stick. Default gravity is "center" for both directions.

Author:
rosmord
